key_result: V1 time-gradient dynamics reconstructed from V12.2. Tick acts as effective local clock rate. d(Tick)/dα < 0 universally. Feedback sign = damping coefficient on Tick gradient landscape.
v1_reconstruction: V1 'local clock rate' = Tick, 'time gradient' = d(Tick)/dm, 'fall to slower time' = drift toward m=-1
gradient_landscape: d(Tick)/dα < 0 for all 5 families. Universal downhill toward slower time.
oscillator_analogy: Negative feedback (ICS) = damped → Tick minimum. Positive feedback (GAN/CNS) = anti-damped → runs away.
